description: Returns VertoDigital's contact information - how to get in touch with the team. Read-only, no side effects, reflects the live /contact page. `format: "summary"` returns a compact JSON object (name, title, email, LinkedIn, response SLA, contact form URL); `format: "full"` (default) returns the complete /contact page as markdown.

format.description: "summary" returns a compact structured object (name, title, email, LinkedIn, response SLA, contact form URL). "full" (default) returns the complete /contact page as markdown.

name: vertodigital_get_contact
